entries.post_text: I've been playing around with FLUX 3 for the last few week - it's an incredibly impressive model. It can generate up to 20 seconds of video across multiple shots with one prompt. This model is so strong at the little details that make a clip look real - a few favorites.
entries.summary: An early-access tester shares a thread of favorite FLUX 3 video generations, emphasizing realistic small details and multi-shot clips lasting up to 20 seconds from a single prompt.

prompt.notes: The creator says the model can generate multiple shots from one prompt, but the prompt text is not included in the top-level post. No prompt was inferred from the visuals.

workflow.details: Creator-reported capability: one prompt, multiple shots, up to 20 seconds.

quality.rationale: Explicit FLUX 3 attribution by the person sharing her own early-access generations; attached video thread; demonstrates multi-shot continuity and attention to realism; original source URL is preserved.

verification.notes: The exact X status URL and post text were independently preserved in a public newsletter embedding the original post. FLUX 3's official launch documentation confirms video generation up to 20 seconds.
